title: Bands, Bars and Washes
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Recipients from data/abstract.json (giftRecipientAsRecorded, from the collector's earlier gallery); minting dates (March 30 to April 4, 2022) and the April 7 airdrop from curation/research/onchain/nnxyz-onchain.json (polygonAbstract); the artist's posts of March 18 and 26, April 7, 12 and 13, 2022 from curation/research/social/x-posts.json; the buyer counts from curation/research/onchain/README.md. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 25 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Marks laid side by side until they build a surface. The twenty-five works in this room are bands, bars and washes: stripes of color stacked or crossed, blocks set in rows, grids drawn over soft fields. No faces, no figures. They were painted in one week, March 30 to April 4, 2022, on a different chain from everything else here, and the room follows the title numbers because the series carries no date for each work.

Two kinds of mark do most of the work. One is a broad vertical stroke, dragged down the square and left to drip, so that a picture is a row of poles or a curtain of color. The other is a thin straight line, drawn across or diagonally over the strokes, so that the surface becomes a plaid, a ladder or a grid. Behind nearly every set of bars is a soft field of color, grey, pink, maroon or cream, and the bars sit on it like rain on a window. After five months of teeth, the artist spent a week making pictures with nothing in them to look back.

They were made to be given away. On March 18, 2022, the artist posted the idea of a proof of support, something minted on another chain for everyone who held an ink, and on April 7 wrote that everyone should now have received their airdrop. Forty-four of the fifty-two paintings went to listed wallets: the board's builder got the first, danielsheldon the ninth, scrimshaw the sixth. The artist called it a small thank you for creating some value outside Nifty Ink. The calm in these pictures was aimed at particular people, and the record says who.

chapters.title: Loops, Plaids and Diagonals
chapters.opening: The first four numbers. Thick loops inside a square, a speckled field, a plaid of thin lines, and diagonals crossing a blotched ground. The first went to Austin Griffith, who built the board.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #01
works.text: A square of pink and yellow on orange, and inside it thick loops of green and yellow drawn in rectangles, with thin lines of pink, white and purple running over them. The loops circle a dark center like a knot. The ground around the square is flat orange, and the pink inside it is soft and cloudy. It is the first of the Abstract works by number, and the only one in the room with a shape at its center. It was given to Austin Griffith, who wrote the software Nifty Ink runs on and who, two months earlier, had put ether into the artist's empty mainnet wallet. The first abstract went to the person who made the board. It is a knot, and it is warm.
works.caption: Thick green and yellow loops drawn in rectangles inside a soft pink square on flat orange.
works.reading: The green loops are the widest strokes in the picture, drawn with square corners. The yellow ones run beside them in a lighter, thinner line. Thin pink hatching fills the lower left, and a grey smudge at the lower center is the darkest mark.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #02
works.text: A field of speckles in yellow-green, pink, blue and gold, with thin vertical lines rising through it like stems, and a band of magenta across the lower edge.
works.caption: A field of yellow-green, pink and blue speckles with thin vertical lines rising through it like stems.
works.reading: The speckles are tiny dots laid in drifts, denser at the top and thinner below. The vertical lines are drawn in pale green and brown. A row of pink dashes crosses the upper third, and the lower edge is a soft magenta band.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #03
works.text: A plaid of thin blue, green and yellow lines over purple, with thick orange and yellow brush strokes laid across it at the left and lower center, and pink at the right edge.
works.caption: A plaid of thin blue, green and yellow lines over purple, thick orange strokes laid across it.
works.reading: The plaid is made of straight horizontal and vertical lines, close together, so the purple ground shows through as a weave. The orange strokes are thick and ragged, drawn in bunches. Pale yellow bars hang down the right edge like fringe.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #04
works.text: Diagonal lines in red, green, blue and yellow cross the square from both corners over a ground of soft blotches in teal, grey and pink. A dark hairy cross sits at the upper left, and bunches of orange, blue and navy strokes lie scattered over the lines. It is the room's busiest surface, with four layers: the blotches, the thin diagonals, the thick strokes, and the hairy marks on top. The diagonals make an X across the whole square, the mark that cancels an eye in every other wing, here with no eye under it, and the picture is cheerful.
works.caption: Diagonal lines in red, green and blue cross a ground of soft blotches, thick orange strokes scattered over.
works.reading: The diagonals run both ways, so they make a net of diamonds. The blotches beneath are cloudy and translucent, with white and teal patches at the left. The dark cross at the upper left is drawn in short bristly strokes, and the orange bunches are thick enough to show the brush.

chapters.title: Curtains and Washes
chapters.opening: Numbers six to sixteen. Vertical strokes dragged down the square, soft washes behind them, and grids and bars drawn over. The sixth went to scrimshaw, whose heads hang in the last wing.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #06
works.text: Dense colored dabs in blue, magenta, yellow and green, with dark bristly streaks running down through them like trunks; this is the one that went to scrimshaw.
works.caption: Dense colored dabs in blue, magenta, yellow and green, dark bristly streaks running down through them.
works.reading: The dabs are short, thick and overlapping, and the colors are at full strength. The dark streaks are drawn in fine scribble with red and green edges, four of them, from the top edge to the middle. A pale lilac patch sits at the left.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #07
works.text: Black lace of scribble over soft pink, yellow, mauve and olive, with thin horizontal lines through it.
works.caption: Black lace of fine scribble over soft pink, yellow and olive patches, thin horizontal lines through it.
works.reading: The scribble is drawn in tight loops of black and dark green, in vertical drifts, so it hangs like moss. The color patches behind it are soft-edged. The horizontal lines are pale and few, and a block of green scribble at the right is the densest patch.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #09
works.text: Pale vertical bars in grey, tan and lilac, washed thin, with a band of orange and black across the middle like a railing seen through fog. The bars drip at their lower ends. Two dark poles stand at the left and the center, and a few thin lines are scratched into the wash at the upper right. It is the quietest picture in the room, and the first where the wash is the subject. It went to danielsheldon, one of the artists whose inks nnxyz liked most often on the board. A railing in fog, given to a painter: it is the nearest thing in the series to a letter.
works.caption: Pale vertical bars washed thin in grey and tan, an orange and black band across the middle.
works.reading: The wash is built from overlapping translucent strokes, so the bars show through each other. The railing is two dark horizontal lines with orange blocks and white dashes between them. Fine speckle sits in the lower corners like dust.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #10
works.text: Grey-blue bands washed over a dark ground, with small red and blue squares set along them like lights, and a pale bar at the upper right.
works.caption: Grey-blue bands washed over dark, small red and blue squares set along them like lights.
works.reading: The bands run across the square in soft horizontal strokes, with vertical pale bars at the left edge. The squares are small and opaque, red along the middle band and blue at the lower left. Speckle drifts over the lower half.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #11
works.text: A green and beige wash ruled with thin lines into a grid, orange drips running down from the top, and turquoise at the corners.
works.caption: A green and beige wash ruled into a grid, orange drips running from the top.
works.reading: The grid lines are dark and uneven, drawn by hand over the wash. The orange at the top is thick and runs in drips through the upper third. A black blot sits at the right of center, and the lower left is scratched with grey.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #12
works.text: Pink and grey vertical bands with a maroon stripe and a dark blue one, washed and splattered, with a pale blue block at the lower right.
works.caption: Pink and grey vertical bands, one maroon stripe and one dark blue, speckled with orange.
works.reading: The bands are soft and overlapping, drawn down the square in broad strokes. The maroon and blue stripes are narrower and darker, like posts. Orange speckle drifts across the upper half, and the pale block at the lower right sits inside the pink.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #13
works.caption: Orange and yellow blocks with magenta bands, rows of white horizontal lines across the center, drips below.
works.reading: The blocks are soft-edged and bright, stacked across the upper half. The white lines are drawn in short rows like a ladder laid on its side. A grey and white block at the lower right has black drips falling from it.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #14
works.text: Pale translucent blocks stand on maroon like windows, with yellow horizontal lines drawn across them, dashed and broken.
works.caption: Pale translucent blocks stand on maroon like windows, yellow horizontal lines dashed across them.
works.reading: The blocks are white, pink and blue, washed thin so the maroon shows through them. The yellow lines are drawn at three heights, each broken by short vertical dashes like a fence. A red block at the lower left is the one solid color.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #15
works.text: A patchwork of soft color: turquoise, orange, red, purple and yellow blocks laid side by side and overlapping, each one translucent, with darker drips falling through them. There is no line at all. The blocks are soft at every edge, and the color builds up where they cross, so the picture is deepest at the center and palest at the edges. It is the one work in the room with nothing drawn on it, only laid down, and it went to one of the wallets that bought the artist's inks most often on the board.
works.caption: A patchwork of soft translucent blocks in turquoise, orange, red, purple and yellow, with darker drips.
works.reading: The blocks are roughly the same size and stacked in loose columns. Where orange crosses blue the color goes brown; where red crosses purple it goes dark. The drips are thin vertical runs of darker color through the lower half.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #16
works.text: Pastel brush blocks in pink, yellow, lilac and olive with a purple band across the middle and white strokes laid over them.
works.caption: Pastel brush blocks in pink, yellow, lilac and olive, a purple band across the middle, white strokes over them.
works.reading: The blocks are opaque and brushy, with visible edges. The purple band runs the full width just below center. The white strokes are short and thick, laid across the top and the middle like tape.

chapters.title: Bars and Rungs
chapters.opening: Numbers twenty-five to thirty-four. Dark grounds with bright vertical bars, a pale one with rungs, and plaids of stripes and dabs. The artist was fighting the Polygon marketplaces that week and said so in a dozen posts; none of it shows here.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #25
works.text: A soft patchwork of yellow, mauve, orange and green with black and white line scratched over it in loops and ladders.
works.caption: A soft patchwork of yellow, mauve and green with black and white line scratched over it in loops.
works.reading: The patchwork is like the earlier soft blocks, but a drawing sits on top: thin black loops, white zigzags, a few box shapes. The line is loose and continuous, and it crosses the whole square. Yellow bars run across the upper third.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #26
works.text: Dark ground, and across it vertical bars of red, magenta and cyan, with a horizontal band of cyan near the bottom making a cross. The bars are brushy and bright against the dark, and they drip. A patch of pale pink hangs at the upper left like a lantern. It is the strongest contrast in the room, light bars on a near-black field, and the nearest the series comes to the dark grounds of the masks. Nothing in it has teeth. The dark is simply where the color is brightest.
works.caption: Vertical bars of red, magenta and cyan on a dark ground, a horizontal cyan band making a cross.
works.reading: The red bars are thickest, at the center and the right. The cyan is laid in three places: a bar at the left, a band across the lower third, and a bar at the right. Soft speckle in pink and white drifts over the top, and the lower edge is scribbled in dark red.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #28
works.text: Dark ground with vertical streaks of green, magenta, blue and yellow, a black column at the center, and a hatched band of fine lines along the bottom.
works.caption: Vertical streaks of green, magenta, blue and yellow on dark, a black column at the center.
works.reading: The streaks are thin and many, laid in vertical runs with scribble between them. The black column divides the square. The band at the bottom is drawn in fine straight lines in red, yellow and blue, like a ruled margin.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #29
works.text: Pale grey bars washed down the square, with black rungs drawn across the right half like a ladder, and teal, red and yellow bars among the grey.
works.caption: Pale grey bars washed down the square, black rungs drawn across the right half like a ladder.
works.reading: The rungs are five or six horizontal black lines, broken and uneven, over a pale grey field. A thick black L shape stands at the upper center. The colored bars, teal at the left, red and yellow at the center, are narrower than the grey ones.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #30
works.text: A cream ground, and on it a red circle at the lower left, blocks of yellow, blue, purple and grey, and thin black lines drawn across in a loose grid. A second circle at the upper right is drawn in line with a yellow half. The red circle is the one large shape in the room, and everything else on the page is arranged around it. A red sun low on a cream page, with a pale moon at the other corner: the room's one picture that could be a place, and it went to a wallet named ironsoul.
works.caption: A red circle at the lower left on cream, blocks of yellow, blue and purple around it, thin lines across.
works.reading: The red circle is soft-edged and translucent, and a band of teal and purple crosses it. The blocks are small and set at the corners of the grid. The line drawing is faint, in black and grey, and includes a few diagonals.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #31
works.text: Red horizontal stripes on a pink ground, crossed by vertical bars of teal, yellow and grey, with black scratches over them.
works.caption: Red horizontal stripes on pink crossed by vertical bars of teal, yellow and grey, black scratches over.
works.reading: The stripes are thick, flat red bands at three heights. The vertical bars are translucent and brushy. The scratches are fine black lines in bunches, at the top and the lower right, and a purple bundle lies at the lower right corner.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #32
works.caption: On maroon, rows of short dabs in yellow, orange, green and lilac crossing in bands, like a woven cloth.
works.reading: The dabs are laid in diagonal rows that cross each other. Green bars sit in a row along the upper third. A patch of bright teal at the lower left and orange at the right are the strongest colors.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #33
works.text: On dark olive, yellow bars and squares with a diagonal yellow band across the lower half, pink dashes in a row across the middle, and fine lines like string.
works.caption: On dark olive, yellow bars and squares, a diagonal yellow band, a row of pink dashes across the middle.
works.reading: The yellow squares are at the upper center and right. The diagonal band runs from the lower left up to the right. The pink dashes cross the whole square at mid height. The fine lines run in tangles over everything, like thread.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #34
works.text: Dense bars in red, teal and yellow, with rows of pink dots and white line scribbled over them in loops.
works.caption: Dense bars in red, teal and yellow, rows of pink dots, white line scribbled over them in loops.
works.reading: The bars run in both directions. The pink dots are set in diagonal rows. The white scribble is drawn in open loops across the whole square, and yellow dashes run in rows at the top and center.

chapters.title: Grid and Page
chapters.opening: Two to end the room: a black grid with splatter, and a near-empty cream page with a few shapes on it. The last went to a collector who had bridged the artist's inks to Ethereum.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #39
works.text: A grey ground ruled with thick black lines into a grid, and across the grid, splatter: black bursts at the upper left and lower right, and bars of red, blue and yellow set between the lines. Where the diagonals of number four made a net of thin lines, here the lines are thick, straight and few, and the marks sit inside the cells. A grid with something thrown at it is the room's picture of order and its opposite, and the splatter wins on points.
works.caption: A grey ground ruled with thick black lines into a grid, black splatter and colored bars set between them.
works.reading: The grid is two verticals and three horizontals, drawn in thick dry strokes. The splatter at the upper left is a burst of black with red and blue inside it. The colored bars are soft and vertical, red at the upper right and blue at the center. Grey dots scatter over the whole.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #49
works.text: A cream page with a few shapes on it: a pink block at the left, a green block at the lower right, a red blob and a yellow blob at the top, a grey smudge, and thin black lines drawn in a loose frame around them. Most of the page is empty. It is the sparest work in the series, and the room ends on it. On April 13, 2022, the artist posted that number 49 was going, in three copies, to the collector who had upgraded the artist's inks from Gnosis to Ethereum. The emptiest painting in the series was the thank-you for the most expensive gesture a collector could make, and the artist chose it for that.
works.caption: A cream page holding a pink block, a green block, two small blobs and a few thin lines.
works.reading: The pink block is drawn in scribble with purple at its base and an outline that does not quite match it. The green block has a cyan center. The red and yellow blobs are outlined in black. The lines run vertically and diagonally, with a few short cross marks.

closing: The plaid of thin lines near the start of the room and the cream page at the end, with its few blocks, were ruled by the same hand. One fills the square with lines until it is cloth. The other draws a frame and leaves the page bare. Both were gifts, and the quietest things the artist made were the ones the artist chose to hand to other people.
